value.zh-Hant: 秘魯炮兵軍官，參與對智利戰爭；1914年底出任戰爭與海軍部長，1915年2月起任部長會議主席（內閣首長），1916年晉升准將，1919年支持萊吉亞政變並再任戰爭部長。
value.en: Peruvian artillery officer who served in the war against Chile; became Minister of War and Navy in December 1914 and head of the Cabinet in February 1915, was promoted brigadier general in 1916, and backed Leguía's 1919 coup, again serving as war minister.
